metrics.test_coverage: 3 cases: initial value, debounced update, rapid-change timer reset

comments.note: Verified timer cleanup on rapid value changes: the third test correctly advances timers in two phases (200ms + 200ms + 100ms) and confirms intermediate state holds before the final debounced value lands. The clearTimeout in useEffect cleanup correctly cancels pending timers on every rerender.

The useEffect dependency array includes both [value, delay], meaning a delay change also resets the debounce timer. This is correct and safe for the planned usage (fixed 300ms delay at both call sites).
For future hooks using non-primitive T (objects/arrays), callers will need to memoize references to avoid spurious debounce resets. Current usage is string-only, so no issue for this WP.
